description: This file defines an interface ILivenessTestGrain within the 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces' namespace. The interface extends IGrainWithIntegerKey and declares asynchronous methods for getting/setting a label, retrieving runtime and unique IDs, obtaining a grain reference, and starting a timer. It is used for testing liveness and identity within Orleans grain tests.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a string label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the label string for the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a unique identifier for the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains a reference to another ILivenessTestGrain.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer within the grain.
